rules.name: Ambush
rules.description: May be set aside before deployment. At the start of any round after the first, may be deployed anywhere over 9” away from enemy units. Players alternate in placing Ambush units, starting with the player that activates next. Units that deploy via Ambush can’t seize or contest objectives on the round they deploy.

rules.name: Ambush Beacon
rules.description: Friendly units using Ambush may ignore distance restrictions from enemies if they are deployed within 6" of this model.

rules.name: Anti-Cover
rules.description: This weapon ignores Cover.

rules.name: AP
rules.description: AP

rules.name: Armor
rules.description: Counts as having Defense X+.

rules.name: Bane
rules.description: Ignores Regeneration, and when attacking, the target must re-roll unmodified Defense results of 6.

rules.name: Counter
rules.description: May strike first with this weapon when charged, unless this unit is Fatigued.

rules.name: Counter in Melee Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Counter on its weapons in melee. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Defense
rules.description: This model gets +X to Defense rolls.

rules.name: Enhanced Precision Marksman
rules.description: If this model has Precision Marksman, it always gets +1 to hit rolls from Precision Marksman (instead of only when shooting over 9" away).

rules.name: Enhanced Targeting Visor
rules.description: If this model has Targeting Visor, it always gets +1 to hit rolls from Targeting Visor (instead of only when shooting over 9" away).

rules.name: Enhanced Targeting Visor Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Enhanced Targeting Visor. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Fearless
rules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule fails a Morale Test, roll one die. On a 4+ it counts as passed instead.

rules.name: Fortified
rules.description: When units where most models have this rule take hits, those hits count as having AP(-1), to a min. of AP(0).

rules.name: Fortified Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Fortified. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Good Shot
rules.description: This model gets +1 to hit rolls when shooting.

rules.name: Hit & Run
rules.description: Once per round, this model may move by up to 3" after shooting or being in melee.

rules.name: Hit & Run Shooter
rules.description: Once per round, this model may move by up to 3" after shooting.

rules.name: Hit & Run Shooter Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Hit & Run Shooter. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Increased Shooting Range Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get +6" range on its weapons when shooting. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Melee Shrouding
rules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule is targeted by an enemy unit for charging, that enemy unit gets -2" range to a min. of 6".

rules.name: Melee Shrouding Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Melee Shrouding. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Precise
rules.description: Gets +1 to hit when attacking.

rules.name: Precision Marksman
rules.description: When shooting at enemies over 9" away, this model gets +1 to hit rolls.

rules.name: Precision Spotter
rules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 30" and in line of sight of this model and roll one die, on a 4+ place a token on it. Friendly units may remove tokens from their target before rolling to hit to get +X to hit rolls when attacking, where X is the number of removed tokens.

rules.name: Puncture
rules.description: Ignores Regeneration, and when attacking units where most models have Defense 2+ to Defense 3+, this weapon gets AP(+2).

rules.name: Ranged Slayer
rules.description: When using Hold actions and shooting, this model's weapons get AP(+2) if most models in the target have Tough(9) or higher.

rules.name: Ranged Slayer Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Ranged Slayer. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Regeneration
rules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 5+ it is ignored.

rules.name: Slayer
rules.description: When using Hold actions and shooting, or when charging, this model's weapons get AP(+2) if most models in the target have Tough(9) or higher.

rules.name: Stealth
rules.description: When units where most models have this rule are shot from over 9" away, enemy units get -1 to hit rolls.

rules.name: Stealth Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Stealth. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Targeting Visor
rules.description: When shooting at enemies over 9" away, this model gets +1 to hit rolls.

rules.name: Unstoppable
rules.description: This weapon ignores Regeneration, and ignores all negative modifiers which are not from this model's special rules.

spells.name: Aura of Peace
spells.effect: Pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets Fearless once (next time the effect would apply).

spells.name: Coordinated Aggression
spells.effect: Pick up to two enemy units within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units gets AP(1) on their weapons when shooting against once (next time the effect would apply).

spells.name: Deadly Surge
spells.effect: Pick one enemy unit within 12", which takes 9 hits with Bane.

spells.name: Devastating Strike
spells.effect: Pick one enemy unit within 12" in line of sight, which takes 4 hits with Puncture.

spells.name: Killing Blow
spells.effect: Pick one enemy model within 18" in line of sight, which takes 2 hits with AP(1). This effect is resolved as if the target was a unit of [1].

spells.name: Psychic Stabilization
spells.effect: Pick up to three friendly units within 18", which get Enhanced Targeting Visor once (next time the effect would apply).
